title: Two Notebooks
tagline: One of us writes about the places we wander through. The other goes down rabbit holes in science and writes back up. Same kitchen table, two very different notebooks.
about: This is a shared blog with two sections. Travel is for trip stories, photos and practical tips. Science is for long, careful deep dives into how things actually work.

travel.title: Travel
travel.blurb: Trip stories, slow walks, photos and the small practical things we wish we'd known.

science.title: Science
science.blurb: Deep dives into how things work, with the reasoning, the numbers and the sources.

authors.name: Alex
authors.bio: Travels slowly, walks everywhere, and always finds the bakery before the museum.

authors.name: Sam
authors.bio: Reads papers for fun and keeps asking 'but why?' one level further than is polite.
